deviations.what: The four buttons announce the pressed button's type+text to the sap.ui.core.InvisibleMessage a11y service and echo it into the status Text; here a press updates the bound status Text with a generic confirmation (the a11y live-region announce and the per-button identity are not reproduced server-side). The original's 'Infromation' button-text typo is kept 1:1. **e2e-verified 2026-08-01** (scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs interaction, transpiled backend + real browser): pressing a button really round-trips and the bound status Text shows 'A new message was sent to the invisible messaging service.'. What stays unverifiable by machine is the announcement itself - a live region has no assertable rendering.
